$comment: Fill in `command` with your fal.ai CLI (or any image CLI) as an argv array. No shell is used, so no quoting is needed.
Tokens replaced per image: {prompt} {negative} {file} (absolute path to write) {width} {height} {aspect} (e.g. 2:1) {id} {background} (transparent|opaque).

`editCommand` (optional) is used for images that must line up with another one (`alignWith` in images.json). It also gets {ref}: absolute path of that reference image. If it is null, those images use `command` and may not line up.
Your CLI must write the image to {file}. If it only prints a URL, wrap it in a small script that downloads to {file}, and put that script here.
The flags in `shape` are placeholders, not real fal.ai flags. Replace them with your CLI's actual syntax.
Claude Code: the generate-media skill (.claude/skills/generate-media/SKILL.md at the repo root) asks where your CLI is, reads its --help, and fills this in.
